name: Hisaki Mei
source: [url=/c83148]Ryou's[/url] upperclassman and the student council president. She can't say no to anyone asking for her help and tends to worry over whether she's actually helpful or not. Loves large penguins and collecting penguin goods. Mei is also both childhood friends and next door neighbors with [url=/c3234]Hibiki[/url].
